  have hxy : 0 < x + y := add_pos hx hy
  have hyz : 0 < y + z := add_pos hy hz
  have hzx : 0 < z + x := add_pos hz hx

    rw [ha, hb, hc]

    have h₁ : 0 < a := ha_pos
    have h₂ : 0 < b := hb_pos
    have h₃ : 0 < c := hc_pos

      have h_ab_pos : 0 < a * b := mul_pos h₁ h₂
      have h_sq : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≥ 2 * a * b := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b)]

        _ ≥ (2 * a * b) / (a * b) := by gcongr
        _ = 2 := by field_simp [h_ab_pos.ne']; ring

      have h_bc_pos : 0 < b * c := mul_pos h₂ h₃
      have h_sq : b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 ≥ 2 * b * c := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b - c)]
      calc
        b / c + c / b = (b ^ 2 + c ^ 2) / (b * c) := by field_simp [h₂.ne', h₃.ne']; ring
        _ ≥ (2 * b * c) / (b * c) := by gcongr
        _ = 2 := by field_simp [h_bc_pos.ne']; ring
    
    have h_ca : c / a + a / c ≥ 2 := by
      have h_ca_pos : 0 < c * a := mul_pos h₃ h₁
      have h_sq : c ^ 2 + a ^ 2 ≥ 2 * c * a := by

        _ ≥ (2 * c * a) / (c * a) := by gcongr
